content: OpenCode: /connect stores credentials in ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json; API keys, OAuth for ChatGPT Plus/Pro and GitHub Copilot, env vars for Bedrock/Vertex; 75+ providers via models.dev; /models lists; opencode.json whitelists/blacklists, base URL overrides, local Ollama/LM Studio/llama.cpp via @ai-sdk/openai-compatible. Anthropic prohibits Claude Free/Pro/Max OAuth tokens in third-party tools and the Agent SDK (compliance page formalised Feb 2026, enforcement reported from 4 Apr 2026); OpenCode removed its Claude Pro/Max plugin before 1.3.0; API keys and Claude Code itself remain allowed. Cline: Claude Code provider = path to claude CLI, uses subscription limits, limited streaming/caching; Gemini CLI provider via @google/gemini-cli-core OAuth (Gemini Code Assist licence). Gemini CLI --acp exposes a stdio JSON-RPC Agent Client Protocol server used by Zed/JetBrains. GitHub Copilot SDK (GA June 2026; TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java) embeds the Copilot CLI runtime; requires Copilot subscription unless BYOK.
